# KayKit Furniture Bits 1.0

- Upstream: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Furniture-Bits-1.0
- Godot Asset Library: https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/2125
- Author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal. See `LICENSE.txt` in this directory.
- Pinned upstream commit: `96d5930a8dbdb363409bbc2d3341718b00e17c9c`
- Imported: 2026-08-19

Only the runtime GLTF distribution is included: 53 `.gltf` files, their matching
`.bin` buffers, and the shared `furniturebits_texture.png` palette. The upstream
Godot add-on/sample project is intentionally not enabled or copied into `addons`.

These assets are the base furniture-shape library for the table-model map, not
the final visual identity of Channel Dream. Runtime presentation must combine
them with the project's painted cardboard, clay/felt, visible stagecraft, and
absurd broadcast-state language. Quaternius Ultimate House Interior remains a
CC0 supplement for categories that are absent from this pack, such as kitchen
appliances and a fireplace.

Art workflow references (reference only; no media or proprietary game assets are
redistributed):

- Cozy Isometric Room: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fxWpUSkKPl0
- Blender to Godot material workflow: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bTUG7N9pfs4
- Virtual Cottage 2 development log: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cyTkbDZ3bNI

`Virtual Cottage 2` is referenced only for inhabited miniature-room density,
furniture interaction, and natural character occupancy. It is not a reference
for the product premise, stable cozy mood, or productivity-companion UI. No
model, texture, audio, or other proprietary content was extracted from or copied
out of that game.
